test.title: Changes to the village of Eastbrook
test.excerpt: The maps below show the village of Eastbrook in 1995 and in 2020. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features…

document.lead: You should spend about 20 minutes on this task.

chart.alt: Two maps of the village of Eastbrook side by side. 1995: a field of farmland in the north-west; a small school in the north-east; the Main Road runs east–west across the middle; south of the road are a shop (west), a group of houses (centre) and a church (east); the River runs along the south edge with no bridge. 2020: the farmland has been replaced by a new housing estate; the school is larger and has a new sports field beside it; the Main Road is unchanged; the shop has been replaced by a supermarket with a car park south of it; the houses and church are unchanged; a new bridge crosses the river in the south, near the houses.
